data.name: Tonga
data.summary: Tonga taxes residents on worldwide income at up to 25%. The Income Tax Act 2007 has no capital gains tax: only gains on business assets are taxed, so a private investor's gains appear untaxed (low confidence). Dividends from Tongan companies are exempt; foreign dividends are property income taxed at up to 25% with a foreign tax credit. No inheritance, gift or wealth tax was found.

regimes.name: Ordinary tax residence
regimes.description: Residents taxed on worldwide business, employment and property income at 0-25%; no tax on private capital gains found.
regimes.eligibility: Resident individual: home in Tonga at any time in the year, or 183 days' presence in any 12 months commencing or ending in the year (Income Tax Act 2007 s. 4(3)).

capital_gains.summary: No capital gains tax. Gross income consists of business, employment, property and other income (s. 11); gains are taxed only on disposal of a business asset (s. 12(c)). Gains on a privately held portfolio, private company shares or a non-business property appear outside the tax.
capital_gains.important_exceptions: s. 44(5): transmission of an asset by succession or under a will is treated as a disposal by the deceased (relevant to business assets). Business assets include any asset used or held ready for use in a business.

open_questions: No official statement that Tonga does not tax private capital gains was found; the 0% is an inference from the Act's income definitions.
Amendments to the Income Tax Act since 2007 were not reviewed.
capital_gains.rate_basis: Income Tax Act 2007 s. 11-14: only gains on disposal of business assets are in business income; no other charge on gains found. Assumes the family is a passive investor and not 'conducting a business'.
capital_gains.professional_trader: If investing amounted to a business, gains on business assets would be business income at up to 25%. A rented property could be a business asset.
capital_gains.foreign_assets: Residents are taxed on worldwide income (s. 11(2)), but private capital gains are not income.

dividends.summary: A dividend paid by a resident company to a resident person is exempt (s. 21). Foreign dividends are property income of a resident (s. 14), taxed at the individual rates (25% above TOP 70,000 from July 2021), with a foreign tax credit (s. 62).
dividends.exemptions_thresholds: Individual rates from July 2021 (Ministry page): 0% to TOP 12,000; 10% to 30,000; 15% to 50,000; 20% to 70,000; 25% above 70,000. The 2017 Order set the rates on 'chargeable income of an individual' (then 0/10/20/25%).

dividends.rate_basis: Domestic: s. 21 exempt = 0. Foreign: top individual rate 25% before the s. 62 foreign tax credit.
dividends.withholding_outbound: 15% non-resident withholding on dividends, interest, royalties and fees (s. 79; Ministry page).
dividends.treaty_network: No comprehensive tax treaties found (not verified). US dividends bear 30% US WHT, creditable up to Tongan tax.

wealth_tax.summary: No net wealth tax and no recurring levy on financial assets.

inheritance.summary: No inheritance, estate or gift tax was found. Under the Income Tax Act, transmission of an asset on death is a deemed disposal by the deceased (s. 44(5)), but only gains on business assets are taxable.

sources.title: Income Tax Act 2007 (Act No. 10 of 2007)

open_questions: No official statement on the absence of estate/gift duty found.
Land in Tonga cannot be owned freehold by foreigners (leases only; general knowledge, not verified).

residency.tax_residency_test: Income Tax Act 2007 s. 4(3): resident if the individual has a home in Tonga at any time during the year, is present 183 days in any 12-month period commencing or ending in the year, or is a government employee posted abroad. Part-year rules apply on arrival and departure.

data.us_citizen_notes: US citizens remain subject to US federal income, estate and gift tax on worldwide income and assets wherever they live; the app adds the federal layer. Where local tax on portfolio income is nil there is nothing to credit against US tax.
